title: Meet IronClaw
script: Your AI agent can read your email, hold your keys, and run commands on your machine. That should worry you — and it's why IronClaw exists. IronClaw is the secure, open-source agent harness, built in Rust, running where you choose: your machine, your server. What it learns stays yours — conversations, memory, credentials — encrypted at rest. Every tool call crosses a security boundary: sandboxed execution, a leak detector scrubbing secrets before the model ever sees them, and approval gates on anything risky — that's the default. Connect it where you live: Slack or Telegram. Equip it with extensions: GitHub, Gmail, your Google workspace — every tool auditable. Teach it your playbooks as Markdown skills — thirty-two ship in the box. Then hand it a routine, and stop babysitting your automation. IronClaw. The agent you don't have to trust blindly.
